sources.title: devendradhakad/autodroid-litert-community-moonshine-tiny · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Moonshine Tiny is a 27M-parameter encoder-decoder speech-recognition model from Moonshine AI (formerly Useful Sensors), introduced in Moonshine: Speech Recognition for Live Transcription and Voice Commands. It transcribes English speech and is designed for fast on-device inference.
